title: "Visualization - Sea Ice Concentration vs Tiam"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-28"
---
This visualization compares annual mean sea ice concentration in two Antarctic subregions, Anv and Avi, from 1978 to 2024.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
sea_ice_data <- read.csv("SeaIceConc_Clean.csv")
head(sea_ice_data)
```

```{r}
sea_ice_data <- sea_ice_data %>%
  filter(Subregion == "Anv" | Subregion == "Avi")

sea_ice_annual <- sea_ice_data %>%
  group_by(Year, Subregion) %>%
  summarise(
    average = mean(Mean_sea_ice_conc, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Visualization: Sea Ice Concentration vs Time

```{r}
sea_ice_graph <- ggplot(
  sea_ice_annual,
  aes(
    x = Year,
    y = average,
    color = Subregion
  )
) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Sea Ice Concentration vs Time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Yearly Mean Sea Ice Concentration (%)",
    color = "Region"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Anv" = "red", "Avi" = "blue"))

print(sea_ice_graph)
```

```{r}
dir.create("plots", showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  filename = "plots/sea_ice_two_regions.png",
  plot = sea_ice_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

The visualization compares the yearly average sea ice concentration between Anvers Island and Avian Island. It showed us that the Avian Island generally has higher sea ice concentration than Anvers Island. There is a clear decrease in sea ice concentration over time.
